title: Normalise a batch by column and by row
brief: Rescale a group of numbers to mean 0 and variance 1, then apply the same rule down each column for batch norm and along each row for layer norm.
hints: normalise_group: subtract x.mean(), then divide by np.sqrt(x.var() + eps). np.var already divides by the number of values, which is what you want.
batchnorm_forward reduces over axis 0 and layernorm_forward over axis 1. Pass keepdims=True to mean and var so the results broadcast against x.
Compute istd = 1 / np.sqrt(var + eps) and xhat = (x - mean) * istd, and return out = gamma * xhat + beta. gamma and beta have shape (D,) and broadcast across the rows for both layers.
The cache is the tuple (xhat, istd, gamma, axis). The next chapter reads it for the backward pass.
